title: BiomX Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the exercise of an option to acquire 100% of Mandragola Ltd.'s stake in DR. Frucht Systems Ltd. (DFSL), representing 60% of DFSL's voting equity, for total consideration of $750,000 cash, a $3,000,000 convertible note, 923,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for 923,000 shares, and a five-year warrant for 3,692,000 shares, subject to stockholder approval.
key_points: BiomX acquired 60% of DFSL through exercise of an exclusive option granted under an Option Agreement dated March 31, 2026

Total consideration includes $750,000 cash (with $450,000 advanced), a $3,000,000 convertible note, 923,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for 923,000 shares, and a five-year warrant for 3,692,000 shares
All securities are convertible/exercisable at $12.00 per share, subject to stockholder approval required by NYSE American rules within 120 days

DFSL is a developer of LADAR-based detection systems for security, defense, and critical infrastructure applications, including counter-UAS, perimeter security, wide-area surveillance, and rail/metro safety
A revenue bonus of 5% applies if DFSL records $25,000,000 or more in annual revenues in fiscal year 2027 or later
Mandragola agreed to provide a credit line to support DFSL's development and debt obligations
